title: TCG:LGS-B1

objectives.text:
Put Puppeteer Dendras and the Spirit Portal into zone 2. Put Rampaging Overlos into zone 4.
All heroes get "Spirit Speed-I can move up to 3 zones."

If you banish Rampaging Overlos, you win.
